pr_body:
Manually rolling over the data stream was 1. not necessary, and
2. causing issues when it happened after ILM had already rolled over, which would make ILM convert the second backing index into a searchable snapshot as well, possibly preventing the data stream from being deleted.

Fixes #107421
pr_title: Avoid rolling over twice in searchable snapshot test

review_comment: Should we check this before we index the document? The chances it will rollover so quickly is unlikely but better to be sure right?

Ah yeah I think I thought about that but concluded that this was fine as `backingIndices.get(0)` would point to the same index before and after rollover, but I forgot to take into account that the searchable snapshot action removes the original index, of course. Good suggestion, will do :+1:

Ah no nvm, I remember why I didn't move the check before the document indexation; the data stream doesn't exist yet before the document is indexed :smile:. I'll move the check and add a `PUT _data_stream/...` request.
